messages:
Ava (PM): Stratus Health just reconfirmed they want Private deployment + Dedicated pool + customer-managed KMS. Their target go-live is end of Q2. Can we lock scope and dates so Sales can get the 12mo commit?
Ravi (Sales): They said yes to a 12mo if we hit the infra milestones. Legal already flagged KMS language as a blocker :eyes: 
Sam (AE): @Ava can you run a quick pre-SOW checklist call with their infra team? Wed preferred. They want deterministic perf numbers.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Reality check — KMS + VPC + audit logs into their SIEM by EoQ2 is tight but doable if we de-prioritize any custom dashboard work for v1.
Jordan (Eng Lead): Rough resource ask: 4 engineers full-time for ~6 weeks for VPC peering, KMS pathing, and e2e tests. We should ship with standard telemetry and provide logs to their SIEM rather than a custom UI.
Lina (Customer Success): They require key rotation policy + 2yr audit log retention. Also want per-route latency SLOs in SOW.
Priya (Legal): We can accept 2yr retention but need a DPA addendum and clarity on whether KMS is customer-managed or Redwood-managed. That needs explicit language.
Ava (PM): Proposal: ship core infra (VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, ledgered audit logs) by 2025-06-24; postpone per-route latency SLA enforcement and fancy cost-optimizations until Q3. That gives Sales what they need without overcommitting. Thoughts?
Ravi (Sales): :thumbsup: That's exactly what they'd sign. They want the infra firm for Q2 and are fine with SLAs moving to Q3 as long as SOW notes that.
Ava (PM): Draft launch checklist I'm planning to include in the SOW:
```
Launch checklist (v0.1):
- VPC peering / private control plane configured
- Customer-managed KMS integrated + key rotation docs
- Audit logs exported to customer SIEM, retention 24 months
- Dedicated GPU pool reserved (initial: 8x A100-equivalent)
- E2E perf targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms (baseline; SLA rollout in Q3)
- Canary fallback to hosted catalog if capacity issues
```
Maya (Solutions Eng): We should add feature flags for the KMS path and SLA enforcement: `stratus_kms_v1`, `stratus_slas_v1`. That lets us roll Q3 items safely.
Jordan (Eng Lead): Agreed. Also need to lock model variants we'll host for them (2 quantized variants + one full-precision). Put the exact list in the SOW to avoid surprises.
Ava (PM): I'll update the SOW draft and share: https://redwood.internal/docs/stratus-sow-draft — please comment inline.
Sam (AE): Customer wants a firm eng resource commitment by EOD Friday so they can finalize procurement on Monday. Can Eng confirm headcount?
Jordan (Eng Lead): I can commit the 4 engineers headcount but need manager approvals for names. Will confirm by Friday EOD.
Priya (Legal): I'll add a clause: latency SLAs are "targeted" and will become binding after the Q3 SLA rollout. KMS: customer-managed required, Redwood only acts as operator for key policy enforcement. I'll review SOW after Ava's edits.
deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2025-06-18 02:00-04:00 UTC — may affect Dedicated onboarding. :warning:
Ava (PM): Noted — avoid major infra work during that window. @Jordan can you adjust schedule if maintenance affects our timeline?
Jordan (Eng Lead): Will add a 1-week buffer. New target ship date -> 2025-06-30 if no blockers.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll prepare onboarding checklist and call agenda for Wed (include SIEM contact, key rotation policy, and test plan).
Ravi (Sales): Great — I'll loop Stratus once the SOW is updated and we have the Eng confirmation.
Ava (PM): Thanks all. Action items: Jordan confirm names by Fri EOD; Priya draft DPA language; Maya prepare feature-flag plan; Lina schedule Wed call and share agenda.
